label: NGA FM05-12 (2023), Physical and Mechanical Properties of Typical Soda Lime Float Glass
notes: Primary source for the glass row. Also the source of the 19 MPa design stress at 0.8 percent probability of breakage, which is the number that matters more than the 41 MPa mean MOR.

label: Swift Glass, Properties of Soda-Lime-Silica Float Glass
notes: Corroborating only. Agrees with NGA FM05-12 on modulus, MOR and density.

label: CoorsTek Advanced Alumina, AD-995 column
notes: Prints both tests: 4-point flexural MOR 300 MPa at 20 C, against roughly 380 MPa by 3-point. The shipped value is the 4-point figure.

label: DuPont Zytel 101L NC010 PA66 datasheet
notes: ISO 527-1/-2, dry / conditioned pairs: yield stress 82 / 55 MPa, tensile modulus 3100 / 1400 MPa. The conditioned half is why the row carries an E range.

label: ASTM A36/A36M
notes: Dual-designated 36 ksi [250 MPa]. Value corroborated via Wikipedia and beamdimensions summaries; the standard itself was not opened.

label: ASTM A992/A992M
notes: Dual-designated 50 ksi [345 MPa]. Corroborated via secondary summaries; standard not opened.

label: ASTM A240/A240M
notes: Specifies the same 30 ksi [205 MPa] minimum yield for Types 304 and 316. Corroborated via Penn Stainless and pipingpipeline summaries; standard not opened.

label: Steel Tube Institute / Atlas Tube, ASTM A500 minimum yields
notes: Round vs shaped split confirmed: Grade B round 42 ksi, Grade B shaped 46 ksi, Grade C round 46 ksi, Grade C shaped 50 ksi. Cross-checked against atlastube.com/atlas-observer/what-the-spec-minimum-yields-of-astm-a500/.

label: Aluminum Association, Aluminum Design Manual Table A.3.4
notes: US-only document, so the shipped SI values are 3-figure conversions: 6061-T6 Fty 35 ksi = 241 MPa, 6063-T5 Fty 16 ksi = 110 MPa. Confirmed via eng-tips and beamdimensions AS 1664 summaries; manual not opened.

label: AISC Specification for Structural Steel Buildings
notes: E = 29,000 ksi [200 GPa] for structural steel. Widely corroborated; specification not opened.

label: APA Glulam Design Tables (EWS S475)
notes: 24F-V4 Douglas fir: Fbx+ 2400 psi, Ex 1.8e6 psi. Confirmed from search result text; PDF not archived here.
